# Cliff Yang (楊子清)

**Cliff Yang** (楊子清) is a columnist for [[sources/taiwanjustice-net||taiwanjustice.net (台灣公義網)]], with 65 articles archived from the site's column section; see also [[organizations/taiwanjustice-net||台灣公義網]].

## Identity Snapshot

- **English:** Cliff Yang
- **Also seen:** Yang Zi-qing — Hanyu gloss. Archive bylines and TAH #269 use Cliff Yang.
- **Chinese:** 楊子清
- **Role:** Columnist
- **Source:** taiwanjustice.net column category
- **Articles:** 65

## Story
楊子清 Signs as Cliff Yang and is listed as a columnist on taiwanjustice.net with 65 articles, while the TAH Foundation encyclopedia carries him twice, as #127 Cliff Yang 楊子清, Conductor (2015/01) and as #269 (2015/02). His employment record lists Xerox and IBM, and his family record lists a daughter, Lisa Yang. On the choral side he leads 以立合唱團 and serves as 理事長 of 以立音樂基金會: on 2018-06-17 he announced the 以歌會友 free concert at Arcadia Community Church, recalling that 2016 joint performance with a Korean alumni chorus, and in 2018 he was 活動總召 of the second 亞洲合唱節 in Los Angeles, where he also conducted the closing mass chorus. He also keeps returning to Taiwan to conduct: in 2001 the 半音合唱團 gave the 陳文成博士殉難20週年紀念音樂會 at 國家音樂廳 with him conducting, after which 陳水扁 received the group at 總統府; in 2022-10 he led the chorus through 威爾第《安魂曲》selections in Pasadena and at 紐約卡內基贊克爾音樂廳; and in 2023-11 the 希望之光 tour brought the chorus to 高雄衛武營國家藝術文化中心音樂廳 with 台北弦樂團 and 台北室內管弦樂團. Teaching runs alongside the podium — his 楊子清老師音樂短講 series covers 美聲唱法的技巧 from 聲區 to 節奏, traces 曾道雄's teachers, and the 影音 area also carries 楊子清父子二重唱：直到祂再來. His taiwanjustice.net column work reaches its widest audience through the site's Key Entities listing, "Yang Zi-qing (楊子清) — 65 articles", and on 2024-05-13 he took the chorus to Pasadena's Mayfield school and called it 國民外交 for Taiwan.

## Disambiguation

**楊子清** signs as Cliff Yang (楊子清 Cliff Yang 音樂教室). The earlier hedge that this might be a different person is closed: the bylines name him as conductor.
